blocks.text_en: The E2E_P02Check() function shall set Status to E2E_P02ST A TUS_OKSOMELOST if the following conditions are true: • the calculated DeltaCounter is greater-than 1 but less-than or equal to MaxDelta- Counter (i.e. 1 < DeltaCounter =/< MaxDeltaCounter); and • the NoNewOrRepeatedDataCounter is less than or equal to MaxNoNewOr- RepeatedData (i.e. State NoNewOrRepeatedDataCounter =/< Config MaxNoNewOrRepeatedData); and • the SyncCounter equals
